page: Microsoft Azure HX176-48rs is an x86_64 architecture server instance from the HX family, powered by Intel processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs and a substantial memory allocation of 1408.0 GB, yielding approximately 29.33 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration includes 4332 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. Additionally, the instance is RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capable, enabling low-latency, high-throughput networking interfaces suitable for clustered environments and high-performance computing workloads.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and large local NVMe storage capacity, the HX176-48rs offers resource density tailored for memory-intensive applications. It is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and memory-bound scientific simulations that require dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
